public_definitions.name: signedA

public_definitions.name: signedW
public_definitions.text: def signedW (t : ℕ) : ℝ := if t = 0 then 0 else if t = 1 then -2 else 1

public_definitions.name: eta
public_definitions.text: def eta (t : ℕ) : ℝ := if t = 1 then 2 else 1

public_definitions.name: feedback
public_definitions.text: def feedback (t : ℕ) : ℝ := if t = 0 then 1 else if t = 1 then -2 else 2

public_theorems.name: signed_weights_complete
public_theorems.full_header:
theorem signed_weights_complete :
    signedA 0 = -2 ∧ signedA 1 = 3 ∧ signedA 2 = -1 ∧ signedA 3 = 4 ∧
    signedW 0 = 0 ∧ signedW 1 = -2 ∧ signedW 2 = 1 ∧
    (∑ t ∈ range 3, (signedA t - signedA (t + 1)) * signedW t) =
      signedA 0 * signedW 0 - signedA 3 * signedW 2 +
        ∑ t ∈ range 2, (signedW (t + 1) - signedW t) * signedA (t + 1) ∧
    (∑ t ∈ range 3, (signedA t - signedA (t + 1)) * signedW t) = -13 ∧
    -(signedA 3 * signedW 2) = -4

public_theorems.name: one_step_free_terminal_complete
public_theorems.full_header:
theorem one_step_free_terminal_complete (a w : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ t ∈ range 1, (a t - a (t + 1)) * w t) =
      a 0 * w 0 - a 1 * w 0 +
        ∑ t ∈ range 0, (w (t + 1) - w t) * a (t + 1) ∧
    (∑ t ∈ range 0, (w (t + 1) - w t) * a (t + 1)) = 0

public_theorems.name: constant_zero_weights_complete
public_theorems.full_header:
theorem constant_zero_weights_complete (a : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, (a t - a (t + 1)) * c) =
      a 0 * c - a T * c + ∑ t ∈ range (T - 1), (c - c) * a (t + 1) ∧
    (∑ t ∈ range T, (a t - a (t + 1)) * c) = (a 0 - a T) * c ∧
    (∑ t ∈ range T, (a t - a (t + 1)) * (0 : ℝ)) =
      a 0 * 0 - a T * 0 + ∑ t ∈ range (T - 1), ((0 : ℝ) - 0) * a (t + 1) ∧
    (∑ t ∈ range T, (a t - a (t + 1)) * (0 : ℝ)) = 0

public_theorems.name: ogd_three_step_complete
public_theorems.full_header:
theorem ogd_three_step_complete :
    eta 0 = 1 ∧ eta 1 = 2 ∧ eta 2 = 1 ∧
    (∀ t < 3, 0 < eta t) ∧ ¬ (∀ t, t + 1 < 3 → eta (t + 1) ≤ eta t) ∧
    feedback 0 = 1 ∧ feedback 1 = -2 ∧ feedback 2 = 2 ∧
    (∀ t < 3, BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescentSource.FeasibleRegularLoss V (realLoss t)) ∧
    (∀ t < 3, gradient (realLoss t) (ogd t) = feedback t) ∧
    ogd 0 = 0 ∧ ogd 1 = -1 ∧ ogd 2 = 3 ∧ ogd 3 = 1 ∧
    (∑ t ∈ range 3, (‖ogd t - 2‖ ^ 2 - ‖ogd (t + 1) - 2‖ ^ 2) / (2 * eta t)) =
      ‖ogd 0 - 2‖ ^ 2 / (2 * eta 0) - ‖ogd 3 - 2‖ ^ 2 / (2 * eta 2) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ t ∈ range 2,
          (1 / eta (t + 1) - 1 / eta t) * ‖ogd (t + 1) - 2‖ ^ 2 ∧
    (∑ t ∈ range 3, (‖ogd t - 2‖ ^ 2 - ‖ogd (t + 1) - 2‖ ^ 2) / (2 * eta t)) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) ∧
    ‖ogd 0 - 2‖ ^ 2 / (2 * eta 0) = 2 ∧
    -(‖ogd 3 - 2‖ ^ 2 / (2 * eta 2)) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) ∧
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ t ∈ range 2,
      (1 / eta (t + 1) - 1 / eta t) * ‖ogd (t + 1) - 2‖ ^ 2 = -2

public_theorems.name: osd_three_step_complete
public_theorems.full_header:
theorem osd_three_step_complete :
    eta 0 = 1 ∧ eta 1 = 2 ∧ eta 2 = 1 ∧
    (∀ t < 3, 0 < eta t) ∧ ¬ (∀ t, t + 1 < 3 → eta (t + 1) ≤ eta t) ∧
    feedback 0 = 1 ∧ feedback 1 = -2 ∧ feedback 2 = 2 ∧
    (∀ t < 3, BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.SubdifferentiableOn V (extendedLoss t)) ∧
    BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientPolicy.LegalFeedback V eta extendedLoss 0 policy 3 ∧
    (∀ t < 3, BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientPolicy.selected V eta extendedLoss 0 policy t = feedback t) ∧
    osd 0 = 0 ∧ osd 1 = -1 ∧ osd 2 = 3 ∧ osd 3 = 1 ∧
    (∑ t ∈ range 3, (‖osd t - 2‖ ^ 2 - ‖osd (t + 1) - 2‖ ^ 2) / (2 * eta t)) =
      ‖osd 0 - 2‖ ^ 2 / (2 * eta 0) - ‖osd 3 - 2‖ ^ 2 / (2 * eta 2) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ t ∈ range 2,
          (1 / eta (t + 1) - 1 / eta t) * ‖osd (t + 1) - 2‖ ^ 2 ∧
    (∑ t ∈ range 3, (‖osd t - 2‖ ^ 2 - ‖osd (t + 1) - 2‖ ^ 2) / (2 * eta t)) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) ∧
    ‖osd 0 - 2‖ ^ 2 / (2 * eta 0) = 2 ∧
    -(‖osd 3 - 2‖ ^ 2 / (2 * eta 2)) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) ∧
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ t ∈ range 2,
      (1 / eta (t + 1) - 1 / eta t) * ‖osd (t + 1) - 2‖ ^ 2 = -2

    ‖osd 0 - 2‖ ^ 2 / (2 * eta 0) = 2 ∧

import BanditRLProof.OnlineGradientDescentSource
import BanditRLProof.OnlineSubgradientPolicy
import BanditRLProof.OnlineHuber
import BanditRLProof.OnlineHinge
import Mathlib.Tactic

noncomputable section
open Set Finset
open scoped InnerProductSpace

namespace BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

structure Domain (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] where
  carrier : Set E
  nonempty : carrier.Nonempty
  closed : IsClosed carrier
  convex : Convex ℝ carrier

def project (V : Domain E) (z : E) : E :=
  Classical.choose (exists_norm_eq_iInf_of_complete_convex V.nonempty
    V.closed.isComplete V.convex z)

def RegularLoss (V : Domain E) (f : E → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ U : Set E, IsOpen U ∧ V.carrier ⊆ U ∧ ConvexOn ℝ U f ∧ DifferentiableOn ℝ f U

def step (V : Domain E) (η : ℝ) (f : E → ℝ) (x : E) : E :=
  project V (x - η • gradient f x)

end BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent

namespace BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

def iterateVariable (V : Domain E) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → ℝ) (x₁ : E) : ℕ → E
  | 0 => x₁
  | t + 1 => step V (η t) (loss t) (iterateVariable V η loss x₁ t)

end BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent

namespace BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescentSource
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
open BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent

def FeasibleRegularLoss (V : Domain E) (f : E → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ConvexOn ℝ V.carrier f ∧ ∀ x ∈ V.carrier, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x

end BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescentSource

namespace BanditRL.OnlineConvex
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] 

def SourceProper (f : E → EReal) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, f x ≠ ⊥) ∧ ∃ x, ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)

end BanditRL.OnlineConvex

namespace BanditRL.OnlineConvex
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] 

def SourceSubdifferential (f : E → EReal) (x : E) : Set E :=
  {g | ∀ y, f x + (inner ℝ g (y - x) : EReal) ≤ f y}

end BanditRL.OnlineConvex

namespace BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
open BanditRL.OnlineConvex

abbrev Domain := BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.Domain E

def SubdifferentiableOn (V : Domain (E := E)) (f : E → EReal) : Prop :=
  SourceProper f ∧ ∀ x ∈ V.carrier, (SourceSubdifferential f x).Nonempty

end BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent

namespace BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientPolicy
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
open BanditRL.OnlineConvex

abbrev Domain := BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.Domain E

abbrev SupportPolicy := (t : ℕ) → (Fin t → E → EReal) → (Fin (t + 1) → E) → (E → EReal) → E

def history (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) : (t : ℕ) → Fin (t + 1) → E :=
  Nat.rec (motive := fun t => Fin (t + 1) → E) (fun _ => x₁)
    (fun t h => Fin.snoc h
      (BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.project V
        (h (Fin.last t) - η t • p t (fun i => loss i.val) h (loss t))))

def output (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (t : ℕ) : E :=
  history V η loss x₁ p t (Fin.last t)

def selected (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (t : ℕ) : E :=
  p t (fun i => loss i.val) (history V η loss x₁ p t) (loss t)

def LegalFeedback (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal)
    (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (T : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ t < T, selected V η loss x₁ p t ∈ SourceSubdifferential (loss t) (output V η loss x₁ p t)

end BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientPolicy

namespace BanditRL.OnlineHuber
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]
open BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent

def fullSpace : Domain E :=
  ⟨Set.univ, Set.univ_nonempty, isClosed_univ, convex_univ⟩

end BanditRL.OnlineHuber

import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Module
import Mathlib.Tactic

noncomputable section
open Finset
namespace BanditRL.OnlineWeightedPotential

theorem weighted_difference_sum_eq (a w : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, (a t - a (t + 1)) * w t) =
      a 0 * w 0 - a T * w (T - 1) +
      ∑ t ∈ range (T - 1), (w (t + 1) - w t) * a (t + 1)

theorem distance_potential_sum_eq {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (x : ℕ → E) (u : E) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (T : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 < T) (hη : ∀ t < T, 0 < η t) :
    (∑ t ∈ range T, (‖x t - u‖ ^ 2 - ‖x (t + 1) - u‖ ^ 2) / (2 * η t)) =
      ‖x 0 - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η 0) - ‖x T - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η (T - 1)) +
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ t ∈ range (T - 1),
        (1 / η (t + 1) - 1 / η t) * ‖x (t + 1) - u‖ ^ 2

end BanditRL.OnlineWeightedPotential
